answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Work waits on the relic until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the prism of the next round. The grove of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, rewards vest against future work. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
